title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior UX/UI Designer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract



Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the full UX/UI design process, from research and discovery to prototyping and final delivery.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and competitive analysis to uncover user insights and pain points.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user flows, journey maps, and wireframes that guide product direction.
  • Develop high-fidelity UI designs and maintain design systems that ensure cross-platform consistency.
  • Define and advocate for UX best practices, accessibility standards, and inclusive design principles.
  • Independently identify design opportunities, propose solutions, and make strategic design decisions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure feasibility, usability, and design consistency.
  • Present design rationale and research-backed recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Must-Have Requirements

  • 7+ years of UX/UI design experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing research-driven design decisions.
  • Proven ability to independently lead design initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Expertise in user research methods (interviews, surveys, usability studies, A/B testing).
  • Strong proficiency with modern design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, InVision, Miro, etc.).
  • Experience creating and maintaining design systems and component libraries.
  • Solid knowledge of information architecture, interaction design, and visual design principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex problems into elegant, user-friendly solutions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence non-design stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Software - Backend
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos procurando uma pessoa Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend para atuar com impacto técnico transversal em nossos produtos e sistemas. Essa é uma posição estratégica, com grande poder de influência técnica, sem papel formal de gestão.

Se você é apaixonado por engenharia de software, adora resolver problemas complexos com elegância e tem perfil de liderança técnica, essa vaga é pra você!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência como engenheiro(a) backend atuando com sistemas distribuídos e de larga escala;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software com Golang ou JavaScript ;
  • Experiência com Kafka, arquitetura orientada a eventos, microsserviços e APIs robustas ;
  • Conhecimento prático em Docker, Kubernetes e cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Domínio de CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e boas práticas modernas de engenharia;
  • Forte base em arquitetura evolutiva, DDD, SOLID, clean code ;
  • Excelente comunicação técnica e empática .


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Experiência com GCP e práticas avançadas de CI/CD;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou publicações;
  • Ter puxado iniciativas de melhoria contínua com impacto entre vários times.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Golang Developer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who thrives in building scalable, high-impact solutions and who seeks to influence not just technology but also the direction of the product. You’re looking for a company where innovation and ownership go hand in hand, and where your contributions directly shape outcomes.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in full-stack development with a focus on Next.js, Go, and MySQL .
  • Strong expertise in AWS services including ECS Fargate, CloudWatch, RDS, S3, and IAM.
  • Proven background in data engineering, data workflow architecture, and pipeline development .
  • Hands-on experience managing end-to-end product delivery (CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, DevOps, DBA tasks).
  • Familiarity with Geo Spatial Data, AdTech, and Online Advertising platforms .
  • Demonstrated experience with performance optimization, diagnosing bottlenecks, and implementing preventive measures .
  • Ability to clearly communicate about complex technical and organizational problems, and to propose iterative, actionable solutions.
  • Comfortable working in iterative/agile development environments with frequent releases.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and provide transparent status updates.
  • Self-motivated and organized, with experience owning projects from concept to production .
  • Nice-to-haves: Python, Rust, Metabase, ForestAdmin, Jira, Confluence .
  • Proficiency in English, as the role requires direct communication with US-based teams and stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deliver features and improvements to the product suite in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.
  • Collaborate with management, engineers, and stakeholders to uphold quality and delivery standards in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
  • Advocate for and implement improvements to product quality, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Solve technical problems of moderate to high complexity, proposing and delivering sustainable solutions.
  • Write and maintain clean, maintainable, and scalable code, ensuring consistency across the codebase.
  • Conduct code reviews and help establish and reinforce coding best practices.
  • Identify and address technical debt and propose improvements to team efficiency.
  • Take ownership of projects, shipping features and improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating on larger initiatives.


Qualifications

  • Go, MySQL
  • AWS ECS Fargate, CloudWatch, RDS, S3, IAM
  • Data workflows, pipelines, and architecture
  • RESTful APIs and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
  • Performance optimization and debugging in production environments
  • Geo Spatial Data, AdTech, and Online Advertising experience

title: Copywriter
description:
Descrição da Empresa : A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos procurando profissional de copy para estar a frente das criações dos nosso conteúdos e planejamentos

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ter computador
  • Ser criativo e estratégico
  • Ter experiência com copy
  • Ser comprometido com prazos e organização
  • Se locomover para trabalho presencial em Campinas- SP


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Criar copy de conteúdos para o Instagram

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About CleverTap:

CleverTap is the world’s No. 1 retention cloud that empowers digital consumer brands to increase customer retention and lifetime value. CleverTap drives contextual individualization with the help of a unified and deep data layer, AI/ML-powered insights, and automation, enabling brands to offer hyper-personalized and delightful experiences to their customers.


More than 1,300 customers in 100 countries and across 10,000 apps — including Gojek, ShopX, Canon, Electronic Arts, TED, English Premier League, TD Bank, Carousell, AirAsia, Papa John’s, Tesco, Kotak Mahindra Bank, SonyLiv, Swiggy, PharmEasy, and Dream11 — trust CleverTap to achieve their retention and engagement goals and grow their long-term revenue.


Backed by leading investors such as Sequoia India, Tiger Global, Accel, CDPQ, and Recruit Holdings, the company is headquartered in Mountain View, California, with offices in Mumbai, Singapore, Sofia, São Paulo, Bogota, Amsterdam, Jakarta, and Dubai. For more information, visit clevertap.com or follow on LinkedIn and Twitter.


About the Function:

We are outcome driven and we run with heart while leading with our core values:

P : Act with First Principles

I : Take Initiative

L : Seek to Learn

O : Take Ownership of Outcomes

T : Help Achieve Together

S : Speak up then Commit


About the Role:

We’re in hyper-growth mode, and this role is instrumental in keeping us on our upward trajectory. This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about sales and looking to use this opportunity as a launchpad into outside sales. Learn firsthand how your efforts lead to opportunities for the company and become skilled in researching potential customers, creative outreach, enticing potential clients.


What will you do:

  • Begin the Relationship: As the first point of contact for future clients, you will enthusiastically explain CleverTap’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest. Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities.
  • Customer and Industry Knowledge: Customers are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded customer and industry knowledge. Researching customers’ business and staying informed on industry trends will be keys to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to plan for success, pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high-level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.


What are we looking for?

Must have:

  • At least 3 years of B2B sales experience, preferable in a SaaS-based product company
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed sales team
  • Strong and professional communication skills -- written, verbal, presentation
  • Aptitude to manage numerous requests and time demands concurrently, while achieving production goals from assigned territory or set of accounts
  • Promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals and key deliverables. Acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company


Good to have:

  • Fluency in Spanish
  • Experience using Salesforce Sales Cloud is a plus
  • Knowledge of MarTech solutions


Measures of Success:

  • Qualified leads
  • Funnel size
  • Conversion rates


Competencies:

  • Functional: Mobile marketing expertise, Martech understanding, Result oriented are desirable
  • Behavioral: Problem Solving, Consultative selling, Communication and presentation skills, Negotiation Skills


Who will you report to: LATAM BDR Team Lead


Why join us?

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Agriculture Specialist
description:
We are looking for Image Annotation Analyst having background in Agriculture from Brazil. If you are interested and reside in Brazil, kindly apply to the post on urgent basis as we are anticipating the project to get started this week.


Please find the details below: -

  • Hourly Rate: $16 per hour

  • Bachelor’s/master’s degree in agriculture

  • Prior work with street view imagery of agricultural datasets.

title: Ilustrador(a) / Artista Digital Freelancer até Dezembro – Início Imediato / Digital Artist Until December – Immediate Start
description:
Ilustrador Freelance – Início Imediato


Envie sua inscrição aqui:


A Scopio está contratando ilustradores e artistas digitais para entregar arquivos PSD editáveis e em camadas para um projeto global de tecnologia.

Este é um contrato remoto temporário que vai até dezembro. Os artistas devem atender a requisitos rigorosos para PSDs em camadas e deverão entregar de 10 a 20 arquivos até 7 de outubro de 2025 como parte do processo de integração.


Responsabilidades

  • Produzir ilustrações em PSD de alta qualidade, editáveis e em camadas (não são aceitos JPEGs nem exportações achatadas).
  • Entregar arquivos que atendam às especificações técnicas:
  • Tamanho mínimo: 2000×2000 px, 150 DPI, RGB.
  • Camadas organizadas com nomes claros em inglês (ex.: Character_1, Background_Sky).
  • Não serão aceitos PSDs achatados/rasterizados nem obras geradas por IA.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente e cumprir prazos curtos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada na criação de ilustrações em PSD com camadas (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Capacidade de entregar 10–20 arquivos PSD até 7 de outubro de 2025 como lote de teste.
  • Forte habilidade em ilustração, incluindo personagens, cenários, objetos e cenas abstratas/editoriais.
  • Domínio em Photoshop, Illustrator (com exportação para PSD) ou Procreate (com exportação para PSD).
  • Compromisso com altos padrões de qualidade e organização de arquivos (guia fornecido).
  • Não serão aceitos: imagens geradas por IA, PSDs achatados, ícones, logotipos ou arquivos sem camadas editáveis.

title: Estagiário da Área Comercial
description:
Estágio Remunerado em Administração – Área Comercial 

Sobre a Waterloo

A Waterloo é uma consultoria ambiental que apoia empresas a encontrarem soluções sustentáveis e estarem em conformidade com a legislação. Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) para atuar na área comercial , aprendendo na prática como funciona a rotina de propostas, prospecções e organização de documentos.

O que você  fará  no dia a dia

  • Auxiliar o time comercial nas solicitações de propostas para fornecedores/parceiros;
  • Organizar pastas e arquivos digitais;
  • Apoiar o comercial na pesquisa de mercado e prospecção de novos clientes;

·       Apoiar o comercial em negociações junto aos fornecedores/parceiros;

·       Apoiar em tarefas administrativas gerais relacionadas à área comercial;

  • Atualizar e controlar documentações administrativa/jurídica;
  • Cadastrar e atualizar os sistemas CRM (Omie e Funil de Vendas);
  • Apoiar na atualização dos indicadores comerciais.

O que buscamos

  • Estar cursando Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade de comunicação;

·       Proatividade

·       Boa redação e comunicação escrita;

  • Conhecimento básico em Word, Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto.

title: Vendedor, Subgerente e Gerente de Loja – Boulevard Shopping Belém
description:
Vendedor, Subgerente e Gerente de Loja – Boulevard Shopping Belém


O que buscamos!

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados por atender e encantar clientes! Se você tem empatia, escuta ativa, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de proporcionar experiências únicas, essa oportunidade é para você. Na Lindt, acreditamos que cada atendimento é uma chance de criar conexões verdadeiras e surpreender. Valorizamos quem contribui para um ambiente de loja vibrante, acolhedor e cheio de energia positiva onde o trabalho em equipe e o cuidado com cada detalhe fazem toda a diferença.

Venha construir momentos inesquecíveis conosco!


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial – Lindt Boulevard shopping Belém (Belém - PA)


VENDEDOR

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento direto ao cliente, garantindo uma experiência de compra positiva por meio da apresentação, degustação e recomendação de produtos.
  • Atuar com foco no atingimento das metas comerciais, contribuindo de forma ativa para os resultados da loja.
  • Executar as atividades de venda, promovendo os produtos da companhia de forma consultiva, clara e eficiente.
  • Manter a organização, limpeza e conservação do ambiente de loja, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões globais de apresentação e atendimento.
  • Cumprir prazos e realizar tarefas operacionais com qualidade e atenção aos detalhes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e apaixonado por chocolates.


SUBGERENTE (VENDEDOR MASTER)

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a gestão e o desenvolvimento da equipe, contribuindo para o bom desempenho do time e assegurando a continuidade das ações gerenciais da loja, com foco no alcance das metas comerciais.
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos resultados, acompanhando indicadores, propondo estratégias e identificando oportunidades que contribuam para o atingimento dos objetivos definidos pela companhia.
  • Atuar nos controles operacionais da loja, garantindo a execução dos processos diários. relacionados a vendas, estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho organizado e eficiente.
  • Apoiar, sempre que necessário, a administração geral da loja, colaborando com a condução das atividades da equipe, o desempenho comercial e o atendimento às demandas da matriz.
  • Participar das trocas de turno, garantindo o repasse claro e preciso de informações, destacando ocorrências relevantes, pendências e atividades concluídas, com o objetivo de manter a comunicação alinhada entre as equipes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Vivência em liderança de equipe ou apoio à gestão será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e com forte senso de responsabilidade.
  • Paixão por encantar clientes e apaixonado por chocolates.


GERENTE DE LOJA

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar, recrutar e desenvolver a equipe da loja, de acordo com os padrões e diretrizes da companhia, garantindo a formação de times de alta performance alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os resultados de vendas, propondo estratégias comerciais e identificando oportunidades para maximizar o desempenho e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Gerenciar os processos operacionais da loja, assegurando a execução eficiente das rotinas diárias, incluindo vendas, controle de estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente organizado e colaborativo.
  • Atuar como multiplicador do programa global de atendimento, implementando e sustentando boas práticas de gestão e relacionamento com o cliente nas lojas próprias, reforçando os fundamentos aprendidos nos treinamentos.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo (ensino superior completo ou em andamento será considerado um diferencial).
  • Experiência sólida em vendas e atendimento ao cliente, com atuação comprovada em gestão de equipes no varejo.
  • Habilidade em liderar, desenvolver e motivar times, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em resultados, organização e capacidade de tomada de decisão.
  • Excelente comunicação, proatividade e paixão por encantar clientes.
  • Afinidade com o segmento de chocolates ou produtos premium será um diferencial.



O que oferecemos para todas as posições!


Em nossa empresa, valorizamos cada colaborador como um pilar essencial do nosso sucesso. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios únicos que cuidam de você e de sua família!


  • Oferecemos benefícios de alimentação que valorizam sua autonomia. Com nosso VR e VA, você decide como e onde se alimentar, com qualidade e liberdade.
  • Convênio Médico: Nosso plano de saúde e odontológico garante o cuidado que você e sua família merecem.
  • Convênio com Academias: Bem-estar que faz parte do seu dia a dia! Temos parceria com academias para que você possa manter a energia e a saúde em alta. (Total Pass)
  • Remuneração variável Mensal: Valorizamos quem faz acontecer!
  • Aqui, você colhe os frutos do seu desempenho por meio de uma remuneração variável vinculada aos KPIs definidos e conforme a política vigente da empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida: Porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Nosso seguro de vida garante proteção e segurança em qualquer momento da jornada.
  • Desconto nos Produtos Lindt: Desfrute dos nossos chocolates inigualáveis com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.
  • Vale-Transporte: A gente cuida do seu caminho até aqui! Oferecemos VT conforme a legislação, para facilitar sua rotina.


Junte-se à Lindt

Venha encantar o mundo com chocolate!

Seja parte de uma equipe que transforma o cacau na mais pura arte.

Encante. Inove. Faça história na Lindt.

Inscreva-se e faça parte do legado!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer


Highlights

⚡ Work on scalable and innovative applications

Remote flexibility with global teams

Career growth in fast-paced technology environments


Role Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our development team. You will help design, build, and maintain applications that power modern businesses, contributing across the full software lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

• Develop full-stack or back-end solutions with modern frameworks

• Work closely with product managers and designers on requirements

We are a global technology company building transformative software solutions. Our culture values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

title: FBS Sr Finance Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (PST)


What You’ll Do:

You’ll develop the IT annual budget and obtains sign-off by budget owners; prepare IT cost allocations to the business units for IT services and any assigned financial reports; monitor expenditures for assigned services, ensuring compliance with corporate policies; identify ways to automate processes, increasing efficiency and accuracy; review financial implications of new system initiatives and prepares financial analysis reports in support of new projects.


Experience:

  • 5 years of experience.


Skills:

  • Proficiency in English (The interview’ll be in English)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
  • Accounting – Intermediate
  • Forecasting – Intermediate
  • Management Presentation - Entry Level
  • SAP - Intermediate
  • Excel - Advanced


  • Competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus


Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Java/Kotlin
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Java 8 (mínimo);

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Kotlin;

Definição de Arquitetura exercendo o papel de Referência Técnica;

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Spring (Boot, Data, Cache, etc);

Conhecimento em Filas (Rabbit);

Experiência em Filas (Kafka);

Experiência em AWS (SNS, SQS, S3);

Experiência em Git e Git-Flow;

Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL;

Desenvolvimento com foco em qualidade: testes unitários e Sonar(métricas);

Experiência em micro serviços e sistemas concorrentes;

Contínuos delivery (Jenkins);


A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

Alguns diferenciais Invillia:

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

_metodologia exclusiva #GlobalGrowthFramework

Faça uma imersão aqui


Então, se você busca uma oportunidade de trabalhar de onde estiver, em uma empresa dedicada em recriar a sensação de proximidade, de conexão humana, e de se sentir acolhido a qualquer momento, mesmo com todos distribuídos, aqui é o lugar certo.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary:  R$10K - R$17K /month


762 Interactive is looking for a Technical Lead to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin- an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy games. We’re searching for someone with strong leadership capabilities, deep technical abilities & a passion for delivering awesome projects. You’ll be the technical backbone of the studio, overseeing architecture, ensuring code quality, and mentoring developers. This role requires both hands-on coding and leadership skills. 


This is a remote position.  


Please do not apply if you have not worked in the games industry.


Responsibilities  

  • Design and develop architectural proposals and guide the vision for engine systems, ensuring they meet desired functionality and performance standards. 
  • Propose tools or technologies that could enhance the ability to delivery great engine systems support. 
  • Own and drive engine topics and subsequent decision making. 
  • Propose and implement solutions to the challenges of performance and scale. 
  • Oversee code reviews, workflows, and best practices. 
  • Identify technical risks and propose solutions. 
  • Stay up-to-date on game dev tools and industry trends. 
  • Collaborate closely with design, art, and production teams to integrate features. 
  • Lead and mentor a team of developers (Unity/C# focus). 
  • Cultivate the team culture in line with the company’s values and goals. 


Requirements  

  • 6+ years of professional game development experience, with 1+ year of leadership/mentorship role. 
  • Strong proficiency with Unity and C#. 
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in one or more engine related focus areas, including but not limited to: rendering, tools, physics, asset/build pipeline..etc. 
  • System architecture skills. 
  • Ability to debug and optimize code. 
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Solid understanding of performance optimization, memory management, and debugging. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English for daily communication with U.S. leadership. 


Nice To Have  

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • Familiarity with analytics, telemetry, or live-ops systems. 


What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits:
  • Health Insurance 
  • Monthly Meal Stipend 
  • Monthly Internet / Home Office Stipend  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior (RAG Engineer SR)
description:
Estamos contratando: RAG Engineer Sênior - Transformação Digital no Setor Financeiro!


Quer trabalhar na linha de frente da IA aplicada?

Estamos em busca de um(a) RAG Engineer Sênior para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de Recuperação Aumentada por Geração (RAG). O profissional será responsável por projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines que integram grandes modelos de linguagem com sistemas de recuperação de informação em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a arquitetura e implementação de sistemas RAG escaláveis.
  • Desenvolver integrações com LangGraph, MessageBus com Redis e Bedrock (AWS).
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de backend para integrar soluções RAG em aplicações críticas.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes unitários e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Apoiar e mentorar engenheiros juniores no time.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência em Python e FastAPI .
  • Background forte em engenharia de software e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Experiência prática em RAG e deploy em AWS Bedrock, com conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Familiaridade com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e mensageria assíncrona com Redis.
  • Forte background em engenharia de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Importante:

Modalidade de Contratação: PJ (Valor/Hora).

Carga horária: 8h diárias (média de 168h por mês)

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Abono remunerado: 15 dias após 12 meses de contrato (para você recarregar as energias!)

Equipamento: Fornecido pela Sciensa, conforme necessidade da área/projeto.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 17-23k real/mo.


MUST HAVE

3-4 years Back End and 4 years Front End Front end is React

They have to have experience working in Back End and WANT to work in GO

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience software development using JavaScript ES6, HTML5, and CSS3.

Experience with React or React Native, particularly with functional components and hooks.

Experience with statically typed languages such as Go, C, C++, or Rust.

Solid understanding of server-side rendering (SSR), asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and RESTful APIs.

Proficiency in Redux, TypeScript, and NoSQL databases.

Commitment to high-quality coding practices, including comprehensive documentation, active participation in code reviews, and adherence to best practices in software development.

Passion for staying current with the latest software tools and methodologies.

Intellectual curiosity and strong problem-solving skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


PLUS:

Golang experience


D2D:

This specific project is focusing on the enhancements and new features of the Total Wine Website. This specific team works on rewards system and preference center (account information, opt in, etc.)

They have some work planned out in integrating promotion engineering

Doing maintenance work with core team. Updating versions of Node, Go and secruoty vulnerability work. Might pick up backlog of cart and checkout team as well

collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, backend engineers, test automation engineers, UX designers, and Scrum Masters to continuously enhance customer experience.

Develop and maintain modular frontend web and mobile applications, ensuring high performance, maintainability, and testability.

Participate in the development and updating of shared component libraries to enable rapid iteration and consistent development practices.

Mentor and coach mid-level and junior developers, fostering a sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.

Cultivate a positive team atmosphere that encourages open communication, creative problem-solving, and innovative thinking.

Translate functional requirements into responsive components and pages with a mobile-first mentality, championing accessibility best practices.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, ensuring the stability and reliability of applications.

Contribute to code reviews and automated testing efforts, ensuring code quality and meeting coverage targets.

Participate in an on-call rotation with the entire digital and engineering organizations, including Directors and members of the Product team.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About the role

As a Technical Account Manager, you will play a key role in delivering strategic services and support to Riskifield's client ensuring their success and maximizing the value of our solutions

Riskifield's clients come in many shapes and sizes, span multiple software platforms and each one has its own unique story and internal flows. The Technical Account Manager will be working cross-functionally to assist our merchants in scaling up the technical aspects of our products.

Externally, you’ll be working with brand-name retailers who are looking to reduce online fraud rates, and increase their bottom line by optimizing, improving, and enhancing their current Riskified services.

Internally, you'll collaborate daily with various departments including Product, Account Management, Analytics, Data Science, and Development to ensure all relevant aspects of the product life cycle are addressed, being one of the primary points of contact of the Integrations team.

The end goal of the Technical Account Manager is to own the technical aspects of integration efforts, upsells and cross-sales to accelerate our merchants’ growth.


What You'll Be Doing

Serve as the main technical focal point for Riskified’s enterprise merchants, leading upsells, cross-sales and other efforts

Analyze clients’ requirements and business needs from technical and functional perspectives and fit solutions by having a deep understanding of our system and products’ capabilities

Build, monitor, and execute joint project plans with clients

Work closely with Account Management, Sales and Support teams as a technical subject matter expert and offer technical support for new and existing products and services

Proactively Initiate and design process improvements, tools, features, and product enhancements.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English proficiency is required to effectively communicate in a professional environment
  • At least 4 years of experience as a technical account manager/ integrations engineer/ solution engineer / technical project manager working with multiple enterprise customers’ technical and business teams
  • Client-facing: excellent communication and project management skills, working with various stakeholders (PMs, and technical resources)
  • Proven technical background, experience with troubleshooting client issues, reading logs, querying DBs, reviewing code, and offering solutions
  • Experience working with databases and querying languages (e.g. SQL)
  • Excel in critical thinking and technical troubleshooting of multi layered, complex problem statements while maintaining excellent internal and external stakeholder relationships
  • Proven technical background with API integrations; should be comfortable reading logs and source code
  • Prior experience working with internal interfaces such as Development, Product, Account Management, Sales teams in a global organization
  • Enthusiastic problem solver with a proactive approach
  • Superb English writing and communication skills
  • Prior B2B SaaS/PaaS/IaaS experience
  • Experience working with e-commerce and/or payments industry - advantage
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and Magento - an advantage


3 Key areas to focus


Technical Expertise & Troubleshooting:

  • Highlight your proficiency with API integrations
  • SQL
  • log analysis
  • troubleshooting complex technical issues
  • discuss how you've analyzed client requirements and resolved multi-layered challenges in past roles


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management:

  • Emphasize your experience working with diverse teams—including Product, Account Management, and Development—to build and execute joint project plans
  • drive process improvements
  • ensure smooth integration efforts


Client Engagement & Business Acumen:

  • Demonstrate your strong client-facing skills and your ability to translate technical solutions into tangible business value
  • Discuss how you've supported upsells, cross-sales, and enhanced client services to reduce online fraud and boost overall performance

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Descrição da Empresa : A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.




Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Editor de Reels que esteja disposto a aprender mais. Este papel é focado na criação, edição e produção de conteúdo de vídeo para diversos projetos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem editar vídeos, fazer correção de cor, criar gráficos em movimento e colaborar com a equipe para garantir que os projetos atendam aos padrões esperados. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações

  • Produção e Edição de Vídeo: Necessário possuir experiência em edição de vídeo.
  • Além das habilidades acima, serão considerados diferenciais a familiaridade com softwares adicionais de design e edição e experiência comprovada em projetos de vídeo em diversos setores.

Descrição da Empresa : A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.




Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Editor de Reels que esteja disposto a aprender mais. Este papel é focado na criação, edição e produção de conteúdo de vídeo para diversos projetos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem editar vídeos, fazer correção de cor, criar gráficos em movimento e colaborar com a equipe para garantir que os projetos atendam aos padrões esperados. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações

  • Produção e Edição de Vídeo: Necessário possuir experiência em edição de vídeo.
  • Além das habilidades acima, serão considerados diferenciais a familiaridade com softwares adicionais de design e edição e experiência comprovada em projetos de vídeo em diversos setores.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pleno - Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Analista irá atuar em desenvolvimento de sistemas com a linguagem ADVPL.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar com desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, codificação em front-end e back-end;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs Rest em linguagem ADVPL para integração com sistemas parceiros;
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas complexas, com nível de supervisão moderado e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Compreender a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Superior Completo na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em programação ADVPL;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em programação SQL;
  • Desejável conhecimento em processo de negócios backoffice;
  • Vivencia em ambientes que utilizem metodologia Ágil.
  • Banco de Dados – nível intermediário;


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
About MeetGeek

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that doesn't just listen, it acts. We help teams automate meeting capture, summarization, and now, with agentic AI workflows, MeetGeek becomes an active participant in meetings, surfacing data, triggering automations, and even taking actions on your behalf.

From Zoom to Teams to Google Meet, MeetGeek integrates with 5,000+ tools like HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, and more — helping revenue, product, and operations teams turn conversations into structured workflows.

Thousands of companies in 100+ countries already trust us. Backed by top-tier investors and led by a team of AI, NLP, and systems engineering veterans, MeetGeek is redefining what meetings can do.

It's a great time to join MeetGeek. We’re a quickly growing remote team, well-funded, and helping thousands of teams improve their meetings.


About MeetGeek

We’re looking for a Customer Success Representative (Junior) who’s passionate about helping customers succeed — and curious about what’s next in AI, automation, and workflow design.

This role blends customer support, customer success, and operations . You’ll help users go beyond meeting notes and unlock the full power of MeetGeek’s agentic capabilities — from automated follow-ups to real-time action triggers.


About the Role

Technical Troubleshooting

Support users through questions about agent setup, integrations, or system behavior. Collaborate with engineering to resolve edge cases.

title: Android Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a skilled Android Engineer to lead the development of innovative mobile applications with a focus on cross-platform initiatives using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Jetpack Compose. Experience with iOS development is a strong plus, as you’ll help shape our cross-platform architecture and deliver products that seamlessly operate across Android and iOS ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, develop, and maintain mobile applications leveraging KMP for shared business logic and Compose for modern UI design.
  • Collaborate on cross-platform initiatives, contributing to both Android and iOS codebases when necessary.
  • Analyze and optimize high-volume mobile systems for performance and scalability.
  • Refactor and revitalize codebases as technology evolves.
  • Lead development efforts for new products and enhancements to existing products in response to market changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system failures, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
  • Work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative features.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in Android development with proficiency in Kotlin
  • Android Launcher experience is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Exposure to or experience with iOS development (Swift or Objective-C) is a strong plus.
  • Strong architecture design skills and ability to build reusable UI components.
  • Comfortable working on collaborative, fast-paced engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial drive and passion for innovation.

title: Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)
description:
Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)

We are looking for a talented software developer with strong mobile app development experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modern tech stacks, integrating AI into their workflow, and solving complex system-level problems that drive our product forward.

Must-Have Skills
  • Mobile app development experience (iOS preferred, Swift expertise required).
  • Familiarity with CICD pipelines and Git workflows.
  • Strong coding skills in at least two of the following:
  • Python
  • TypeScript
  • Swift
  • Experience building and integrating with REST or gRPC APIs.
  • Ability to solve complex system problems and contribute to key architectural decisions .
  • Strong sense of ownership over your work and outcomes.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Comfortable experimenting with and integrating AI tools in development workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot).
  • Exposure to ML/AI engineering concepts , with strong interest in LLMs, embeddings, and agent-based systems .
  • Background in game design or interactive UX development.
  • Experience with Java or Android development (not required, but a plus).
What We’re Looking For
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment.
  • A developer who doesn’t just write code, but looks for smarter, more efficient ways to ship great products.
  • A team player with a growth mindset, positive attitude, and passion for building high-impact software.

An established and rapidly growing Ads organization is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the Campaign Management team. This team is focused on expanding and improving the core functionality that enables advertisers to create, edit, share, and analyze their ad campaigns with ease.

title: Accountant
description:
Accountant

Remote - Full Time


Join Trivium Group - Our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and a Clutch Award-winning agency


At Trivium Group, we’re more than just a full-service Amazon agency—we’re a powerhouse of passionate experts helping brands scale profitably on Amazon. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, providing top-tier strategic growth solutions without the hefty price tag. Our company thrives on strong systems, sharp people, and solid values—and now, we’re looking for an exceptional Accountant (Remote) to join our team!

Why Join Us?

✅ Competitive Salary $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month

✅ Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

✅ Semi-Flexible Hours Core hours: 09:00 - 14:00 (Eastern Standard Time), with flexibility for the remaining 3 hours

✅ Paid Time Off – 36 PTO days/year

✅ Professional Growth – Develop your skills in a dynamic, international team


TO APPLY, YOU NEED TO CLICK ON THIS LINK & COMPLETE THE APPLICATION FORM


Your Role

As an Accountant at Trivium Group, you will play a crucial role in managing financial data, ensuring compliance, and optimizing financial processes. Your expertise will drive accuracy, efficiency, and financial health for our business.


Key Responsibilities

Reporting to the Head of Finance

Maintain and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Oversee accounts payable, receivable, and payroll (60+ employees)

Verify and record financial transactions in the correct accounts

Prepare monthly financial reports and adjustments

Monitor and report budget variances


What We’re Looking For

Mandatory: Accounting experience working with SOX / US GAAP or international standard - IFRS

Proficiency in QuickBooks or similar software

Fluency in English (B2 or higher)

Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills


Work Setup & Requirements

Full-time (40 hours/week)

Immediate Start Date

Quiet workspace with fast internet, webcam, and microphone

Autonomy & Ownership – You'll have the freedom to make an impact!

title: Profissional Analista Desenvolvedor BPM
description:
Código da vaga:53870


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência Desenvolvedor BPM, para atuar no suporte a operação.

Analisar, mapear e otimizar processos de negócios utilizando a plataforma IBM BAW .

Trabalhar na modelagem de processos e identificar oportunidades de automação e melhoria contínua.

Desenvolver integrações entre o IBM BAW e sistemas externos.

Garantir a qualidade e a conformidade das soluções, com foco em desempenho e escalabilidade.

Documentar processos, fluxos de trabalho e integrações realizadas.



CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Experiência Desenvolvedor BPM, para atuar no suporte a operação.

Desenvolver integrações entre o IBM BAW e sistemas externos.

Garantir a qualidade e a conformidade das soluções, com foco em desempenho e escalabilidade.

Documentar processos, fluxos de trabalho e integrações realizadas.



CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!
